title: Nutanix VirtualMachine
description: Provisions a complete Nutanix AHV virtual machine — with its disks, NICs and serial ports declared inline on the VM — as a single KOG Vm resource. The blueprint also renders the VmConfiguration that holds the Prism Central credentials.

configuration.title: KOG Configuration
configuration.description: The KOG Configuration (VmConfiguration) that holds the Prism Central credentials used to provision the VM.

create.title: Create the VmConfiguration
create.description: Render the VmConfiguration that holds the Prism Central credentials. Set false to reuse a shared VmConfiguration already present on the cluster.

namespace.title: Configuration namespace
namespace.description: Namespace for the VmConfiguration and the Vm resource.

authSecret.title: Auth secret
authSecret.description: Secret holding the Prism Central credentials (keys: username, password).

name.title: Auth secret name
name.description: Name of the Secret with the Prism Central username/password.

vm.title: Virtual machine
vm.description: Core Nutanix AHV virtual machine inputs.

name.title: VM name
name.description: Name of the virtual machine (also used as the Vm resource name).

description.title: VM description
description.description: Free-text description of the virtual machine.
description.default: Provisioned by the Krateo nutanix-virtualmachine blueprint

numCoresPerSocket.title: Cores per socket
numCoresPerSocket.description: Number of cores per vCPU socket.

clusterExtId.title: Cluster extId
clusterExtId.description: REQUIRED: extId of the registered Prism Element (PE) cluster that will host the VM.

categories.title: Category extIds
categories.description: Optional list of Nutanix category extIds to associate with the VM.

disks.title: Inline disks
disks.description: Inline disks. Each entry becomes an entry in the VM's spec.disks (no separate child resource).

storageContainerExtId.title: Storage container extId
storageContainerExtId.description: Optional extId of the storage container; Prism Central picks a default container if empty.

nics.title: Inline NICs
nics.description: Inline NICs. Each entry becomes an entry in the VM's spec.nics.

items.title: NIC
items.description: A single inline VM network interface.

subnetExtId.title: Subnet extId
subnetExtId.description: extId of the subnet to attach the NIC to.

serialPorts.title: Inline serial ports
serialPorts.description: Inline serial ports. Each entry becomes an entry in the VM's spec.serialPorts.

items.title: Serial port
items.description: A single inline VM serial port.

isConnected.title: Is connected
isConnected.description: Whether the serial port is connected.
